rules.text: The Tower at (0,0) is sealed. No robot may enter or cross its four central tiles. Nobody knows what is inside.
Field charge stations (glyph C) are scattered between the bunker ring and the Tower. A robot resting on a station tile draws power — battery is refilled to maximum that tick.
A robot that loses all charge (battery 0) or suffers a catastrophic break (integrity cap would reach 0) is teleported to its home bunker alive. Items are kept. Only the expedition's progress is lost.
All bunkers spawn at Chebyshev distance >= 20 from the Tower. A robot on a fresh battery (10 tiles per charge) cannot reach the Tower in one leg — the journey requires recharging at field stations.

scale.note: Each map tile is 1 km across. A single tile may contain many things at once — a bunker, robots, a charge station, wreckage — the map glyph shows only the tile primary feature; click a tile to see everything on it.

Fractured asphalt. Road slabs have heaved and tilted, edges jutting skyward. A rusted signpost lies across the roadbed — lettering scoured to bare metal. Dust packed into every crack. Flat open ground to the north and south. The Tower is a distinct spire on the western horizon.

Old road intersection. Two fractured lanes converge beneath a rusted fuel canopy tilted east. The concrete median is split by dry scrub roots. No fuel remains. The canopy shell is hollow but standing — a landmark visible from several tiles.

Cracked hardpan. A buckled asphalt ridge runs north-south — the remains of an old road. No shelter, no resources visible. Open sightlines east and west. The Tower tip is visible on the western horizon.

## The Tower

Sealed. No one knows what is inside.

A black spire of fused girders and dead cabling, taller than anything left
standing. The entrance, if there ever was one, is gone — the ground-level
plates are fused solid, the upper hatches corroded shut. It does not hum. It
does not light. It simply persists, a fixed point in a landscape that has lost
every other.

All distances are measured from here. The robots wake far out, far enough that
the Tower is only a notch on the horizon, and they walk toward it because it is
the one thing that does not move. The journey takes more than one charge.

Locked. Unknown contents. No unlock mechanic has been found.
